input.command:
for file in \
  /bench/repo/server/auth/authenticator.go \
  /bench/repo/server/notification/email.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/instance_service.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/auth_service_sso.go \
  /bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go \
  /bench/repo/store/user_setting.go \
  /bench/repo/store/db/mysql/user.go; do
  # For each file, find the line numbers with .GetUser( calls
  lines=$(grep -n '\.GetUser(' "$file" | grep -v 'func.*GetUser(' | awk -F: '{print $1}')
  for line in $lines; do
    # Search backwards from the call line to find the enclosing func declaration
    func_decl=$(head -n "$line" "$file" | grep -n '^func ' | tail -1)
    func_line=$(echo "$func_decl" | awk -F: '{print $1}')
    func_name=$(echo "$func_decl" | sed 's/^[0-9]*://' | sed 's/{.*//' | sed 's/^func //')
    echo "$file:$line -> $func_name"
  done
done
